title: Lilini's Cobblepack [REforged!]
description: Lilini's Cobblepack is a small modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1 with mostly QOL changes and a focus on Cobblemon
body:
**Lilini's Cobblepack** is a small modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1 with mostly QOL changes. It aims to keep the general feel of Minecraft and slightly smoother gameplay, as well as Cobblemon. It was created so I could play with some friends after a partner insisted that we played pokemon and minecraft, at the same time. It also somes with a couple creator-favourite shaders and Cobblemon-based resourcepacks.

![A cobblemon battle!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5f834fac0fe354823f675dd4af108b2c47d81ac.png)




Some highlights include:

[Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon), obviously - And some extra additions 

[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) - For the aspiring cook

[Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) - For nicer World Generation

[Beautify!](https://modrinth.com/mod/beautify-refabricated) - For cozy houses so we can feel at home


This is my first modpack, ever. Any and all feedback is more than welcomed.

It's made out of love and a lot of frustration from ~~brute-force~~ learning, and it wouldn't exist if it wasn't for my lovely friends and partners supporting and encouraging me.


⁯


<details>
<summary>Special Thanks</summary>

Many thanks for the Cobblemon development team for making this pack possible, as well as thanks to Lia, Nina and Sylvana for helping me during the process of making it and a special thanks to Kamilly, responsible for me meeting so many amazing people.

</details>
